user.title: Connect to NEXLORE
user.description: Enter the NEXLORE base URL and a write-level API token. The token is saved in this Home Assistant config entry.

data_description.base_url: The NEXLORE server origin, for example https://notes.example.com.
data_description.api_token: A NEXLORE API token with write access to the space you want to use.

space.title: Choose a space
space.description: Select the writable NEXLORE space to expose as a Home Assistant to-do list.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the NEXLORE API token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement write-level token. The configured base URL and space will be kept.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error.invalid_auth: NEXLORE did not accept this API token.
error.read_only_token: This integration needs a write-level API token.
error.no_writable_spaces: The token cannot write to any available NEXLORE space.
error.invalid_space: The selected space is not writable with this token.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to NEXLORE or read a valid API response.

abort.already_configured: This NEXLORE space is already configured for this server.
abort.invalid_space: The selected space is no longer available.
abort.reauth_successful: The NEXLORE API token was updated.
